headline: Euro Nears 3-Month Low Against Singdollar Amid European Unrest
summary: The euro has declined 4.8% against the Singapore dollar in 2026, nearing a 3-month low amid political unrest in Europe.
why: Currency exchange rates reflect relative economic strength and geopolitical stability between the Eurozone and Asian financial hubs.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Political uncertainty and unrest in Europe weaken investor confidence in the single currency.

why_moved: Political turmoil within Europe weighs on the euro's valuation against safe-haven and regional currencies.
